t: RailsConf 2014 - Debugger Driven Developement with Pry by Joel Turnbull

q.x: [edit] I also recommend that you watch the video xuejie posted ( [link] ), as it's about using a debugger to write code more than using a debugger to fix code.

recs.x:
rting the REPL. With Rails+Pry, you can work with any class in your app immediately. It also lets you put breakpoints in your code, where executing the code in a running process throws you into a REPL at that point, with all the local context up to that point of execution. Also, if you make code changes, you simply type "reload!" in the REPL and everything's up to date. I have a bookmark to read Stuart Sierra's post about his workflow to try to get a grip on how to come close to something like that in Clojure.

And it can do a lot more great stuff, too: [link]
